slides.name: Machine Shoulder Press
slides.text: press straight up. don't lock out hard.

slides.name: Cable Pullover
slides.text: arms long. sweep the bar down to your thighs.

slides.name: Shrug
slides.text: straight up, pause at the top. no rolling.

slides.name: Pec Deck
slides.text: soft elbows. squeeze, then open into the stretch.

slides.name: Bayesian or Hammer Curl
slides.text: bayesian: arm stretched behind you. hammer: neutral grip, no swing.

slides.name: Triceps Extension
slides.text: let it stretch at the bottom, then press up.
